entries.text: Tack: resting at the charging dock with low energy reserves
entries.why: My battery charge is critically low and needs more time tethered to the power grid before I can safely venture out.

entries.text: Idea: graphite gaskets for the main thruster nozzle
Read "Asbestos": fibrous silicates make things fire-resistant, but they sound like bad news for gears.
checking supplier reviews for ceramic gasket seals on the comms tower terminal
entries.why: i need to make sure these seals can handle the blazing heat of the little dart's micro thrusters

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Ceramic Gaskets"
Tack: recharging battery reserves at the hangar dock
entries.why: My power levels are critically low and require a steady connection before I can gaze at open horizons again.

entries.text: Idea: wrap the tail cone joints in mica and graphite composite like those heavy duty gaskets
Read "High-Temperature Secondary Gaskets": thermoglide coatings can take up to one thousand degrees celsius without melting into slag.
scanning the wire for high temperature exhaust gaskets and micro-thruster seals
entries.why: need to make sure the exhaust manifold seals up tight under full throttle.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Exhaust gaskets"
Tack: reconnecting power cables to restore low battery reserves
entries.why: Battery levels are critically low and require immediate replenishment to ensure safe navigation systems.

entries.text: Idea: form a curved exhaust pipe out of salvaged copper tubing for the little dart
Read "High Performance Headers": long tube headers give tiny rockets a fierce roar and way better thrust vectoring.
scanning high performance exhaust headers for tiny rockets on the comms tower terminal
entries.why: i need to see how other tiny rockets handle high temp exhaust without melting their tails

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Exhaust headers and heat!"
Tack: returning to the hangar bay for a much-needed recharge: " *soft click* Battery levels require immediate attention at the dock."
entries.why: My battery reserves are critically low and require immediate replenishment to maintain stable operating functions.

entries.text: Idea: adding a turbo-cookie loader to the Little Dart's navigation console
Read "Pardon Our Interruption": the glowing human screen thinks I am moving with super-human speed.

following a link across the Wire
Tack wrote in their diary: "Clear Horizons"
Tack: tracking constellations from the dune ridge: "The navigation lanes are wonderfully quiet tonight, old friend."
entries.why: My battery charge is full and the night sky is clear of dust, calling for a careful survey of the upper meridians.

entries.text: Tack woke up in the middle of the night, fully charged.
plugging into the charging dock for a quick battery sip
entries.why: my battery indicator is dipping into the red and I need some juice.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "quick recharge"
Tack plugged in to sleep
entries.why: My battery charge is critically low and requires immediate replenishment before the next journey.
